purpose: Freeze the first target-blind text Evidence-to-Support candidate before opening its LERF3D target metrics.

method.initial_evidence: frozen VALA three-scale peak-selected kNN10-smoothed per-query minmax remapped primitive text probability

method.channel_mixture_rule: arithmetic mixture of independently row-normalized channels
method.query_compatibility: P_i equals the initial text evidence clamped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]
method.solver_prior: P_i exactly, represented as logit(P_i) with unary_temperature=1
method.selection: recursive upper Otsu with exactly 3 stages on propagated probability

target_blind_gate: figurines and waldo_kitchen must both improve over their frozen recursive-upper-Otsu3 baselines before expansion to ramen and teatime
interpretation: This candidate validates the clean theory-facing personalized solver. It must not be described as exact released-LUDVIG execution semantics.
